                            ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED B Y THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing / Business Park

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No 5-G in the area bounded by


       North Clybourn Avenue; a line from a point 214.98 feet southeast
       ofthe intersection of North Clybourn Avenue and North Southport
       Avenue as measured at the southwesterly right-of-way line of North
       Clybourn Avenue and perpendicular thereto; the alley next west of
       of North Clybourn Avenue; the alley next south of the intersection
       of North Clybourn Avenue and North Southport Avenue (said alley
       is perpendicular to North Southport Avenue) and North Southport
       Avenue,

to those of a Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

                                    2101-2115 North Southport Avenue
